# Literal fidelity confirmation corpus

Synthetic sources independently authored before the Story244 B-only candidate
freeze on2026-10-06. They are now exposed regression material, not unseen evidence
for future tuning. Native-positive uses Times-Roman; image-positive uses
AndaleMono and includes a conflicting hidden text layer control; ambiguity-negative
uses an embedded font with identical visible I/l glyphs. No original game PDF is
retained here. Exact authored encoding is not proof of optically recoverable text.

Source JSON, golden HTML, PDFs, PNGs, metadata and seal hashes are retained unchanged
from the evaluated panel. Historical metadata absolute paths identify the original
evaluation location and are not portable execution inputs. Use local relative paths.
The frozen production recipe was run on native-positive/native.pdf and the other
two image-only.pdf files, once each. Clear final results:13/13 and23/23 cells;
ambiguous initial result7/8 cells, held before export with both glyph cells flagged.
Hidden-layer pixels match the image-only source; the production reader receives
only the page raster. This control was offline, not a second paid extraction.

Original candidate/evidence: docs/evals/attempts/060-literal-table-fidelity.md.
Do not use this panel as fresh confirmation again.

`retained-manifest.json` lists the portable retained files and their original seal
hashes. `seal.json` is historical: its generation-font and original absolute-path
manifest entries are not included. PDFs embed the required fonts; reading and
scoring this corpus does not depend on the original generator environment.
